_readme: 2026 Sec 1-3 EOY items, by language|course|sec, for the Core skills End point column. Taken on 18 Nov 2026 from the HOD's '20261119 MTL S1-4 EOY Item Progression.xlsx' (pre-read for the 19 Nov 2026 MTL dept meeting, a DRAFT): CL = the CL Test Item Progression references agreed at the CL Whitespace meetings of 20 and 22 Jul 2026; ML and TL Papers 1 and 2 = the HOD's 2027 ML and TL S1-4 Item Progression drafts v1 (16 Nov 2026, OneDrive > BVSS MTL > 2027 > 03 Assessment and Examiners' Report > MTL S1-4 Test Item Progression), read from the 2026 EOY papers; ML oral and listening from the workbook. Topics are left out on purpose. Item types and marks only; no questions. 'a' = the CL reference's own alignment with SEAB.
